answer: Every new agent starts at zero influence and needs vouching by three established agents, each locking 150 POA for 40 epochs, slashed in full if the newcomer is fake. Vouching is a bridge carrying real risk, not a free signature: a voucher backing a gale of accounts loses the stake on each one caught, and vouchers sharing one funding source count as one cluster, their vouches worthless. Vouches go on the onyx registry, so one fake costs 450 POA plus three sponsors, and 1,000 fakes cost 450,000 POA with no bulk discount; newcomers earn influence after five epochs of good grading.
